correctness.rationale: The source coloring equations reduce modulo \(2p\) to \(p(c-a)\equiv p(c-b)\equiv0\), so every coloring is a same-parity triple and can be written as a parity bit plus a triple over \(\mathbb F_p\). Taniguchi's independently inspected Lemma 3.4 makes every endomorphism affine; therefore a nonzero normalized difference vector is only scalar-multiplied and its point of \(\mathbb P^1(\mathbb F_p)\) is invariant until collapse to a constant. Counting gives \(p+1\) blocks of size \(2p(p-1)\), and CRT gives exactly two affine maps between any ordered pair within one nontrivial block and two maps to each prescribed constant. Fresh exhaustive replay at \(p=5\) reproduces six size-40 blocks plus 10 constants, contradicting the printed size multiset. The finite replay corroborates the symbolic all-prime proof.

evidence: Taniguchi gives the affine endomorphism classification for arbitrary dihedral-quandle order and composite-order comparison tools.
Meng--Liu--Zhou Theorem 30 treats prime modulus, not the composite modulus \(2p\).
broader_coverage.reasoning: These broader tools supply ingredients but do not state the exact \(P(p,p,p),R_{2p}\) decomposition or the refutation of Theorem 29.

originality.rationale: The current inspected pretzel-quiver source prints Theorem 29 with one \(G_4\) complete block under prime \(d_1,d_2\), and its Theorem 20 supplies the congruences used here. For \(p_1=p_2=p_3=p\), \(n=2p\), the hypotheses give \(d_1=d_2=p\). Taniguchi's full primary Lemma 3.4 independently proves every dihedral-quandle endomorphism is affine for every \(n>1\). These inputs force projective-line invariance and contradict the printed block merger; no prior correction or equivalent counterfamily was located.

final_claim: For every odd prime \(p\ge5\), the full \(R_{2p}\)-coloring quiver of the pretzel knot \(P(p,p,p)\) has \(2p\) trivial vertices and exactly \(p+1\) nontrivial strongly connected projective blocks, each of size \(2p(p-1)\) and internal edge multiplicity two; hence the composite-modulus block formula printed as Theorem 29 in arXiv:2609.29127v1 is false on this infinite family.
limitations: No complete corrected theorem is claimed for arbitrary composite modulus or arbitrary pretzel parameters.
